description:
Finding (2026-11-17, Optimize session; proposal page ../fz-unneeded-work.html, finding 3; user said 'proceed; work these, push PRs').

Why: DefineModule has no start gate (Job::missing_gates). A module whose code is indexed but whose enclosing scope does not exist yet is started anyway; define_module finds no scope, falls to wait_for_module_indexed and blocks on CodeScoped(owner) or ModuleDefined(parent). On the OptionParser probe DefineModule runs 74 times for 26 modules, 48 ending blocked; 'def main(), do: 1' defines its one module in 5 runs (CodeIndexed, CodeScoped, FunctionDefined, a macro product, done).

What: an indexed module names its enclosing scope (World::module_indexed_parent), so that wait is a gate, as ScopeCode's prelude ladder already is (scope_code_gates). The scheduler parks DefineModule on it without a run.

Not in this ticket: run 1 of a runtime module (ensure_runtime_module registers the source and emits code.submitted from inside the job), and the waits found while expanding the module body.

Signal: no DefineModule completion blocked on CodeScoped or a parent's ModuleDefined; one run fewer per module; output byte-identical; only falling pins move.
title: A module is defined once its enclosing scope exists
